info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Collateral Administration Collection-spec
info.description: This API facilitates the creation and management of collateral administration collections within the banking system. It allows users to submit new collections, ensuring proper alignment with financial regulations and internal policies. Designed for banking professionals and financial institutions, this API streamlines the process of managing collateral assets. Use cases include initiating collections for various banking operations and ensuring compliance with collateral management standards.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new collateral collection, which is essential for managing and tracking collateral assets effectively. Ensure that all required fields are provided in the request body.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a new collection within the collateral administration system. It requires a JSON object that conforms to the defined schema and includes all necessary data fields for successful processing.
